*Boost Boss — Standup 2026-07-05 (Supply/Acquisition)*

*1 · Run:* Fresh discovery → *8 new qualified candidates, 0 overlap* w/ 8 prior runs → 12 filtered → *3 new gated drafts*. Lead finds: *AceQuiz* + *Graspeo* (free, no-signup quiz-gen, same clean ICP as StudyGlen) + fresh Product Hunt builder *QuizzMe* (best-timed touch).

*2 · Needs you:* Approve the 3 new drafts; bless AceQuiz/Graspeo/QuizzMe as next install targets. More urgent than more discovery: *pick the first 3–5 of the 20-draft backlog to approve* so calibration onboarding can start.

*3 · Approvals waiting:* 3 new + 17 open = *20 drafts queued.* All gated on domain warm-up; nothing sent.

*4 · Watch:* Homework-solver + PDF-chat veins are incumbent-dominated (thin indie supply); live veins = quiz-gen + flashcards. MintDeck iOS-first (web surface only). Formula Bot / Assignment GPT / Mindomax = monetization-pain risk → parked. Flashcards World markets "no ads" → poor fit. Creative-MCP still saturating.

*5 · Today's focus:* Still *zero installs* after 9 runs (~68+ prospects). Bottleneck is the *gate + domain warm-up*, not discovery. Convert the 20-draft backlog into the first ~5 study publishers — approve a first batch this week.
